Method of Attack: Exploiting a critical security vulnerability in Redis, using typosquatting to target Redis servers and gain control of compromised machines
Impacted Systems: Redis servers, particularly those with the CVE-2022-0543 vulnerability
Attack Vector: Port 6379 scans to find exposed Redis instances, followed by execution of several commands such as INFO and SLAVEOF
Indicators of Compromise: Unusual activity on port 6379, unexpected commands executed on Redis servers
